title: CCIE Terminal Troubleshooting Playbook
description: JSON Schema for an authored Plan 15 troubleshooting playbook. This is a copy of sidecar/src/ccie_sidecar/troubleshoot/schema.json — keep the two in sync. The Monaco YAML editor in PlaybookEditor.tsx feeds this to monaco-yaml for inline validation.

id.description: Slug; lowercase letters, digits, dashes only. e.g. 'bgp-wont-peer'.

name.description: Human-readable title shown in the picker.

symptom_keywords.description: Free-text keywords used by the BM25 matcher.

vendor.description: Vendor name or '*' for any. Common: cisco, juniper, arista.

platform.description: Platform name or '*' for any. Common: iosxe, nxos, junos, eos.

description.description: Optional long-form description rendered in the picker tooltip and the matcher's 'reasons' chip.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps. The engine starts at index 0 and follows next/on_pass/on_fail/cases.next references.

id.description: Unique step id within this playbook.

type.description: command: run a Tier-0 show command. assertion: evaluate a JMESPath against parsed output. branch: switch on the last assertion value. narration: AI 1-2 sentence explanation. user_prompt: pause and ask the user.

command.description: For type=command: the show command. May reference {{vars}}. Re-classified post-substitution; anything above Tier-0 pauses the run.

expression.description: For type=assertion: a JMESPath expression evaluated against the previous parsed output.

expects.description: For type=assertion: the expected value. Any JSON type.

cases.description: For type=branch: ordered match cases over the previous assertion result.

when.description: The exact value to match. First match wins.

next.description: Step id to jump to when 'when' matches.

text.description: For type=narration: the literal text. The narrator may rewrite it with RAG context if a sidecar is available.

prompt.description: For type=user_prompt: question to ask the user. Pauses the run until answer_prompt is invoked.

on_pass.description: For type=assertion: step id to jump to when expression == expects.

on_fail.description: For type=assertion: step id to jump to when expression != expects.
